entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Get me a person, now! I want to return this piece of junk.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. I can certainly help you today. May I start with your name and order number?
Mark Peterson, order number 87-C-45. I want to return this VeloBand Pulse. I got it 19 days ago for Christmas and I want my money back. End of story.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase, Mr. Peterson. I've pulled up your order. Just to be sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a personal preference?
What does it matter? It's not broken, I just don't like it! It's uncomfortable and the app is useless. I want a refund. Don't try to give me the runaround or I want your manager.
I understand completely, sir. No runaround, I just need to follow the correct procedure. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
You'd better. This is ridiculous. If I don't get a shipping label by the end of this call, I'm blasting VeloFit on every review site on the internet.

Okay, I have your details here. Generally, with wearable items like this, once they're opened, it can be **too late** to send them back. Our return **policy** has to be very careful about **hygiene** and general **sanitation**. However... looking at my system, it confirms you are well within the 90-day return window.
Wait, 90 days? So... you're going to take it back then? No problem?
That's correct. Since you are within that timeframe, I can approve this return for a full refund right now. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label to send to your email on file as we speak.
Oh. Well... okay. That's actually great. I was expecting a fight. Thank you.

You're very welcome, Mr. Peterson. The email should be in your inbox now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box with all the accessories, attach the label, and drop it at a post office. Your refund will be processed once we receive the item. Can I help with anything else today?
